opening.argument: The video follows a concrete card-linking demonstration. The speaker says the aim is to see whether a Vanilla Visa gift card can be added to the PayPal app as a payment method, and the phone displays a debit or credit card linking option. The speaker then describes PayPal asking for the card number, expiration date, and security code before reporting that a Visa appears under banks and cards. Those steps support an instructional purpose, not a demonstrated deceptive financial mechanism. The video also includes referral, shopping, subscription, and affiliate-disclosure material, but the available evidence does not connect those links to such a mechanism.
